governing_rule: A refusal is usually a routing error, not a real limit. Match the task to the surface whose harness does the job natively. Never record a limit you have not tested on the specific asset -- a false limit recorded once is inherited by everything downstream.

status.MEASURED: observed directly on a specific asset, with the instrument named
status.ASSUMED: believed but not tested -- treat as an open question, not a limit
status.REFUTED: previously recorded as a limit, since measured working

conventions.note: Every constraint should carry the exact error string observed. A constraint without one is a rumour.

do_not_route_here: anything needing Ahmed's live account UIs

constraints.statement: Public repos need no credential via codeload.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/tar.gz/refs/heads/<ref>
constraints.note: codeload returns 200 where github.com and api.github.com are proxy-blocked from some environments

constraints.statement: Full 392MB export cannot be opened by any client; the scoped 110MB export opens fine
Model reasoning events are stripped at export and were recorded as permanently unrecoverable
constraints.refutation: 2026-08-30: the LIVE account still serves them. A single post-cutoff sweep recovered 1,469 'thoughts' rows and 275 'reasoning_recap' rows via /backend-api/conversation/<id>. The export strips reasoning; the account retains it. This changes the retrieval strategy for every surface where an export looked lossy -- re-test the live source before accepting an export's omissions.

constraints.statement: A naive extractor records 'thoughts', 'reasoning_recap', 'code' and 'execution_output' nodes as empty because their text is not in content.parts
constraints.workaround: thoughts -> content.thoughts[].summary + .content; reasoning_recap -> content.content; tether_browsing_display -> content.result. Recovering these dropped the empty-row count from 3,061 to 1,374 over the same 6,866 rows.

constraints.statement: Export cutoff timestamps mark where the export FILE was cut, not where conversations ended
constraints.note: Five of six conversations nominated as straddling the 2026-08-23T02:47:08Z cutoff had their last message BEFORE it. The export therefore holds partial copies of conversations that had already completed. Worth diffing live copies against any export, and checking whether other conversations were cut the same way.

claude_in_chrome.capability: cross-surface browser operation, page context, multi-tab, in-page fetch against a site's own backend under the user's live session
route_here: reading and reconciling across logged-in surfaces
adversarial review of another model's output
claude_in_chrome.key_insight: Reading INSIDE the page is unrestricted. Every constraint below is on the RETURN CHANNEL -- getting bytes out of the page into the workspace. Choose the channel deliberately; they do not behave the same.

constraints.statement: javascript_tool return values are DLP-rewritten and truncated. Do not use this channel to carry content.
observed_errors: [BLOCKED: Base64 encoded data]  -- base64 strings AND 64-char hex SHA-256 digests
[BLOCKED: JWT token]  -- any three dot-separated segments, including the filename NAME.part01.jsonl
[BLOCKED: Cookie/query string data]  -- text containing URLs or query strings, i.e. most real conversation content
[BLOCKED: Sensitive key]  -- observed replacing a plain integer byte-count
[TRUNCATED]  -- appended to long string values at roughly 1 KB
constraints.workaround: Use for small scalars and structured counts only. Carry SHA-256 digests out as an array of 32 integers rather than hex -- integer arrays pass unfiltered.

constraints.statement: get_page_text is the clean egress: no DLP rewriting at all, full fidelity, 50,000-character hard cap per call
constraints.observed_error: [output truncated at 50000 of 53843 characters. Pass a larger max_chars (default 50000) to see more, or use read_page with a ref_id to focus on a smaller section.]
constraints.note: Content that javascript_tool blocked came through this path intact and verbatim, verified on the same bytes. It does NOT truncate long physical lines -- a 53 KB <pre> returned continuously, cutting mid-line at exactly 50,000 chars. The suggested max_chars parameter is not exposed in get_page_text's schema.

constraints.statement: read_page returns an accessibility tree and truncates each node's text to ~80-100 characters; unusable for carrying content
constraints.note: A 712 KB <pre> came back as a single node showing its first ~100 chars. Fine for locating elements.

constraints.statement: The real corruption risk is hand-transcribing tool output into a file, not tool truncation
constraints.note: Two of four files built by retyping a clean get_page_text read failed their SHA-256 (8,914 vs 8,930 bytes; 9,340 vs 9,816). Causes: (a) invisible U+E200/U+E201/U+E202 citation delimiters that ChatGPT embeds and that are silently dropped by any retyping; (b) a 2,901-char message losing its last two paragraphs with nothing flagging it.
constraints.workaround: Transfer through a fail-loud encoding (gzip+base64) and hash-check every file. Never reconstruct a file by retyping tool output.

constraints.statement: Extension bridge drops intermittently mid-session (recorded 6+ times across Aug 2026)
constraints.workaround: Verify composer state and route before every send; keep paste-ready fallbacks.

claude_api.capability: same models, no consumer product wrapper, long context
route_here: anything the chat product declines for product-policy rather than capability reasons

constraints.scope: Metamate-specific. This constraint does NOT transfer to any other surface.

constraints.statement: Large-context fan-out fails on model-provider capacity, not on a code defect
constraints.observed_error: AzureApiError code=no_capacity -- 'Your request exceeds the maximum usage size allowed during peak load.'
constraints.workaround: Decompose into small bounded requests; route long-horizon reasoning elsewhere.

constraints.statement: Will not join the permanent setup -- produce portable output only

manus.capability: high-volume task dispatch, measured ceiling 14,400 tasks/day

google_drive.capability: readable from every surface Ahmed runs; return channel for cross-lane artifacts
route_here: anything that would otherwise exist only in a chat reply

constraints.statement: create_file truncates silently when the base64 payload is over-long, and update_file is metadata-only so a truncated upload CANNOT be patched afterwards
constraints.note: A 19,193-byte markdown upload landed as 12,233 bytes with no error returned. The only remedy was trash-and-recreate at a smaller size.
constraints.workaround: Keep uploads small, verify returned fileSize against expected bytes, and prefer a content-addressed destination (see github_via_zapier) where verification is atomic.

github_via_zapier.capability: authenticated GitHub read AND write as principal asibrahim336-hash, without a shell or push credentials

constraints.statement: github_put_file_b64_checked accepts expected_sha256 and expected_bytes and REFUSES the commit on mismatch
constraints.note: Server-side atomic verification. Strictly better than upload-then-check: a mismatched payload never lands at all. github_batch_commit_files_b64 commits several files in one commit.

constraints.statement: Zapier GitHub was recorded as quota-blocked ('insufficient tasks on account')
constraints.refutation: 2026-08-30: GitHubCLIAPI enumerated 45 actions against connection asibrahim336-hash including create_file, batch_commit_files_b64 and put_file_b64_checked. Re-test before recording this as blocked.
